text: MboxMsgInputStream reports IsNonBlocking=false and returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED from ReadSegments. Read serializes state and pumps data as needed; it is not an asynchronous stream just because MboxScanner uses an input-stream pump. Preserve the separate stream and scanner contracts when choosing callers or tests. This is static source and test-code inspection.
